add_image_modality: add image processing functions to DMVR builders for parsing, sampling, decoding, and preprocessing JPEG frames
add_label_modality: add label processing functions to DMVR builders for parsing, densifying, and one-hot encoding class labels
add_text_modality: add text processing functions to DMVR builders for parsing, sampling captions, and tokenizing text sequences
add_audio_modality: add audio processing functions to DMVR builders for parsing, sampling, and resampling audio waveforms
add_spectrogram_modality: add spectrogram extraction functions to DMVR builders for computing log-mel or MFCC features from audio waveforms
